checkpoint: I0B0 round072 6h; independent original dt300 attempt with one paired uninstrumented witness
stage_contract: Bind _nonlinear_predictor_rk2: tracer=_tracer_rk_subcycle(state), first _compute_momentum_residual(state), predicted=tracer with Euler velocities U0+dt*R1_after_drag_compensation; second residual at that exact predicted T/S/velocity/eta. Final UN=U0+dt/2*(R1+R2). Euler stage is an evaluation state, not a second accepted energy increment.
weights_units: A=dx_2d*dy m2; h0=dz_node*wet_mask_z m; M=rho0*A*h0 kg; RHS m/s2; increments m/s; work J; nodal component impulses kg m/s, not conserved Cartesian momentum. Verify binary wet mask and original nodal reference-depth normalization.
work: For every algebraically defined operator component q, deltaUq=dt/2*(Rq1+Rq2). Use the same actual full-N endpoint midpoint Ubar=(U0+UN)/2 for every Wq=sum M*Ubar dot deltaUq. Stage1/2 contributions use dt/2 and that same midpoint; they sum to Wq. Never substitute U_stage dot RHS or sum Euler intermediate energy jumps.
observations: Capture actual existing full-tendency local variables and raw advection before its original FFT/binomial filter. Save full tendency; residual after horizontal, vertical, Coriolis, eta, density mean, wind mean removals and final mask; residual before and after predictor drag compensation; both actual RHS states including second-state updated T/S; actual N endpoints. Filter difference is actual filtered tendency minus actual raw tendency, never a fitted residual source.
groups: pressure_net=full+eta_mean_removal+density_mean_removal; wind_net=surface+mean_removal; advection_net=raw+dealias_difference; linear_subtraction groups and bottom group are separately measured. Full pressure/shear group is not automatically density PE conversion or proven physical input error.
geometry: N holds eta fixed. Report any observed eta change, moving-top Kmat-Kref before/after, and its change separately. It is not a new source fitted to close Kref. Final residual mask is actual RHS map; reference mass zeros dry/ghost nodes. Boundary velocity masks occur outside N and are not charged to N pressure or filter. Projection trace calls recorded separately; tracer face matching is not velocity projection.
checks: Historical35 source hashes and original input/checkpoint identity; diagnostic AST projection restores original mathematical expressions; paired attempted/returned6fields finite and <=1e-11 absolute, identical original validity/boolean gates. At each actual RHS reconstruct all terms, raw residual with and without drag compensation, final increment and fixed-weight work. No N interpretation if any gate fails. Explicitly verify updated second T/S observation and original update relation. Do not invent missing terms or fit residuals.
arithmetic_bounds: eps=float64 epsilon; pointwise RHS/update tolerance=4096eps*max(1,max absolute observed endpoints/RHS/component terms or increments). Sum/work tolerance=4096eps*max(1,sum absolute Kref endpoints and absolute component-work products). Two-stage sum tolerance uses these same absolute terms. Cancellation groups must be within their sum-based bound; only named isolated dissipative maps have nonpositive-work contracts. Advective-tendency dealiasing is not assumed dissipative.
interpretation: Rank signed work groups and report both signs and shares against actual positive deltaK, avoiding percent-of-total when cancellation makes it misleading. Density/buoyancy PE compatibility with reference momentum, moving top tracers and vertical transport remains unproven; no full mechanical-energy closure or pseudoenergy claim. No long integration or initialization repair.
publication: Portable scripts, source diff/hashes, frozen protocol and scalar evidence only; private stage arrays remain local
